findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shop_week, open_shop_handoff, import_recipe_from_url, list_saved_recipes, get_recipe, update_recipe · Private data: list_saved_weeks, open_saved_week, share_week, import_shared_week, start_recipe, list_saved_recipes, update_recipe, get_food_preferences · Public sink: share_week · Destructive: delete_saved_week, update_pantry, delete_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shop_week, open_shop_handoff, import_recipe_from_url, list_saved_recipes, get_recipe, update_recipe · Private data: list_saved_weeks, open_saved_week, share_week, import_shared_week, start_recipe, list_saved_recipes, update_recipe, get_food_preferences · Public sink: share_week · Destructive: delete_saved_week, update_pantry, delete_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
